rationale: Both candidates validate the seq_len removal and the qwen3_tts scoping correctly, but X's 'new' findings are mostly three redundant restatements of the same async_chunk-default concern plus a trivial int()-cast nit, and it leaves the model_config aliasing question unresolved ('please verify') rather than checking it. Y investigates that same aliasing question and resolves it, pins the Low ground-truth concern precisely by citing the sibling default (line 3823) and the real OmniModelConfig default, and explicitly questions whether the split logic (keyed solely on total_num_scheduled_tokens) handles tensors aligned to a different batch axis — directly hitting the latent dual-axis gap later fixed in PR #4910. Y's findings are fewer but higher-precision, better investigated, and more actionable.
